mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom plumbing installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom plumbing installation varies significantly based on the project's scope, from a single fixture replacement to a complete bathroom overhaul. A simple fixture swap might take a few hours, while a full renovation involving re-routing pipes could take several days or even weeks. Factors like the age of the home, accessibility of existing plumbing, and any necessary structural modifications can influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project timeline after an initial assessment, considering factors specific to homes in the East Bay area.
